_comment: R-UI-03, GDD section 14: flags of fictional nations («Срединные земли»), drawn by the client in SVG. scenario.json `sides[].flag` may name one of these ids. stripes: [[colour, share], …] top to bottom (left to right when vertical); emblem: diamond | disc | ring | star in the centre, size = share of the flag height. Designs are invented and deliberately unlike real flags.
